prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE N5 school vocabulary stimulus. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, symbols, watermark or collage. Make the exact spatial/possession/content relation visually unambiguous. Medium: friendly flat 2D educational drawing, no 3D. Exact target BOSSA + AMB + DINOSAURE. One simple open reusable shopping bag containing one friendly dinosaur comfortably sitting inside. Bag walls visibly enclose lower body; dinosaur head, neck, forelimbs and upper torso visible above rim, tail curves up within opening. Only bag and dinosaur, no other contents, ample margins.
